mcpProxy._comment: Central MCP aggregator (tbxark/mcp-proxy), bundled at repo mcp-proxy/ (docker compose up -d mcp-proxy). When install.js runs with --mcp-proxy, each selected server below is emitted into the generated .kiro/settings/mcp.json as { type:http, url } pointing at the proxy — overriding its direct stdio equivalent. AWS/Terraform servers are NOT here: they live on the separate devops proxy (mcpProxyDevops, :9092) so that AWS credentials are mounted into one container only, isolated from general backends like brave/github/obsidian. Host-specific stdio (GitKraken, playwright) is left to the client. Kiro built-ins (github, context7, playwright, memory, sequential-thinking) are intentionally NOT listed — Kiro provides them natively. workloads gate = same rule as mcpServers: [] or omitted means universal, otherwise include only when it intersects the active workloads.

mcpServers._comment: 비-docker MCP 서버. workloads 태그가 있으면 해당 워크로드(IDE 티어)에서만 포함(없으면 범용). CLI 티어는 mcp.json 을 생성하지 않으므로 IDE 전용이다.

mcpydoc.description: Python package documentation and code analysis server (auto-detects venv). Install: pip install mcpydoc. Alt: use command='uvx', args=['mcpydoc'] for zero-install.

mcpProxyDevops._comment: DevOps/FinOps MCP servers for the devops agent, served by the dedicated mcp-proxy container on :9092 (mcp-proxy/config.devops.json + the devops-mcp-proxy compose service). Clients get { type:http, url } — no per-call `docker run`, so no cold-start pull timeout, and one AWS-credentialed container instead of seven. Backends are the official AWS awslabs servers run via uvx (pinned), replacing the 3rd-party acuvity mirrors. Start with: cd mcp-proxy && docker compose up -d devops-mcp-proxy
mcpProxyDevops._credentials: The proxy container mounts ~/.aws read-only and receives AWS_PROFILE/AWS_REGION. SSO profiles need `aws sso login --profile <name>` on the host (the container cannot refresh a read-only mount). terraform, aws-documentation and aws-pricing need no credentials.
mcpProxyDevops._write_policy: Read-biased by design: aws-ecs runs with ALLOW_WRITE=false and aws-iam is read-only unless started with --allow-write (its own default), which must never be added. Mutations go through the devops agent's plan->approve->execute flow using use_aws / the aws CLI, not through MCP.
mcpProxyDevops._removed_aws_core: aws-core is gone: awslabs.core-mcp-server was yanked upstream (reason: 'load individual MCPs'). Its candidate replacement awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server unconditionally mkdirs ~/.aws/aws-api-mcp/ at startup, which conflicts with the read-only credential mount, and it duplicates Kiro's built-in use_aws tool. General AWS API calls therefore use use_aws / aws CLI.

terraform.description: Terraform Registry integration — provider docs, module specs, version/registry metadata for IaC (HashiCorp official, GA)

aws-documentation.description: AWS documentation search, content recommendations, and markdown conversion

cloudwatch.description: CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and Logs Insights — operational troubleshooting (supersedes the narrower cloudwatch-logs)

aws-ecs.description: ECS containerization, deployment, troubleshooting, and infrastructure management

aws-iam.description: IAM users, roles, groups, and policy management with security best practices (sensitive — enable per task)

aws-pricing.description: Pre-deployment cost estimation and optimization from the AWS Price List API — answer 'what will this cost before I deploy?'

aws-billing-cost-management.description: Actual spend, budgets, Cost Explorer, Compute Optimizer, Cost Optimization Hub, and pricing calculator (supersedes the narrower cost-explorer)

_disabled._comment: Copy needed servers to mcpServers. Replace YOUR_*_HERE placeholders with real values. (필요 시 mcpServers로 복사. API 키는 실제 값으로 교체)

laraplugins.description: Laravel plugin discovery — search packages by keyword, health score, Laravel/PHP version compatibility

jira.description: Jira issue tracking — search, create, update, comment, transition issues

confluence.description: Confluence Cloud — search pages, retrieve content, explore spaces

exa-web-search.description: Web search, research, and data ingestion via Exa API — prefer task-scoped use for broader research after primary docs

brave-search.description: Independent web/local search (complements exa). Free tier 2,000 queries/mo: api.search.brave.com/app/keys

sentry.description: Sentry errors/issues via remote OAuth (no plaintext key). Approve on first session; OAuth flow via /mcp.

time.description: Current time + IANA timezone conversion. Requires uv (brew install uv).

fal-ai.description: AI image/video/audio generation via fal.ai models

browser-use.description: AI browser agent for web tasks

omega-memory.description: Persistent agent memory with semantic search, multi-agent coordination, and knowledge graphs (richer than basic memory store)

filesystem.description: Filesystem operations — replace /path/to/your/projects with your actual path

devfleet.description: Multi-agent orchestration — dispatch parallel agents in isolated worktrees. Repo: https://github.com/LEC-AI/claude-devfleet

evalview.description: AI agent regression testing — snapshot behavior, detect regressions in tool calls and output quality. Install: pip install "evalview>=0.5,<1"

_comments.proxies: Two local proxies serve the MCP backends: mcpProxy (:9090, general, opt-in via --mcp-proxy) and mcpProxyDevops (:9092, AWS/Terraform, auto-started for cloud/finops). Both are defined under mcp-proxy/ (config.json / config.devops.json + docker-compose.yaml). Start with `cd mcp-proxy && docker compose up -d <mcp-proxy|devops-mcp-proxy>` — no `docker pull` step is needed since backends run via uvx/npx inside the proxy container.
_comments.env_vars: Replace YOUR_*_HERE placeholders in _disabled section with actual values before moving to mcpServers
_comments.excluded: memory, sequential-thinking, context7, github, playwright are built into Kiro — not listed here
_comments.context_warning: Keep active MCP servers under 10 to preserve context window
_comments.categories: _category_* keys in _disabled are visual section headers only, ignored by MCP clients
